markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (89%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged (tier 3) for low reliability and an ambiguous Benign vs Normal set [F1]; recut and deeper levels drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 89%, Normal 11%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, Normal (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 43% (flagged), OOD 12th percentile [F6] | Suspect input; low OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (all 5 Normal, 94% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors are all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-1.12), but 0/20 AI spot check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.68) lowers invasive risk (19/20 spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (-0.66); caption inconsistent (18/20 spot check) [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.44) lowers invasive risk (20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 4, 7) · context · Nuclear area CV 0.58 exceeds 90% of reference cases [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.001, 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006); top concept `normal_lobules` (0/20) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal: all 5 nearest neighbors are Normal, CONCH–MUSK disagree, and the conformal set includes Normal.
- Low section quality (43% reliability) or 90th-percentile nuclear size variation (regions 1, 4, 7) masks a lesion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 7**: Inspect epithelial nuclei where measured nuclear size variation reaches the 90th reference percentile.
2. **Regions 0, 5, 6, 7**: Check region 0 (highest tile risk) and regions 5–7 (tubules, duct-confined score) for atypia.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 11**: Verify lobular architecture directly (concept unreliable) and decide on drafted recut/deeper levels.
